item.title: [Blog] Building a Purely Local Marketing Ops System with Composio + MCP: A Deep Dive into Content Gen, Publishing Strategies, and Multi-Channel Management
item.description: A comprehensive guide to building a purely local marketing operations system using Composio and Model Context Protocol (MCP). By combining cloud-based platform integrations, standardized local tool clients, and a local SQLite strategy engine, this project enables secure cross-platform marketing with zero additional API costs and zero credential leakage risks.

item.title: Google's Electricity Usage Surges 37% in 2025 Driven by AI Infrastructure
item.description: Google's latest sustainability report reveals a massive 37% surge in its electricity consumption in 2025, marking an over 250% increase since 2019. Driven by AI infrastructure demands, Google Cloud, and YouTube, its data centers consumed over 42 million MWh, matching the power grids of entire nations.

item.title: Lenovo's Tianxi AI Turns 'System Fiction' into Real-World AI Agent Success
item.description: Ever dreamed of having a 'system flow' cheat code in real life? Lenovo's Tianxi AI recently launched a hit micro-drama that turns complex AI Agent concepts into a relatable workplace savior. Through offline protection, hybrid cloud backups, and digital footprint analysis, it shows how personal agents are transitioning from tech concepts to consumer realities.

item.title: Tiangong AI Hits $800M ARR, Nearing China's First Non-BAT $1B AI Company
item.description: Kunlun Wanwei's Tiangong AI achieved a historic milestone in Q2 2026, with its ARR surpassing $800 million. Driven by its AI native drama platform DramaWave, which brought in over $700 million, the company is on track to become China's first non-BAT AI firm to hit the $1 billion ARR mark, proving the massive commercial viability of multimodal AI applications.

item.title: [Blog] A Real Case Study: Why My Claude 5x Max Account Got Suspended After Consuming 2 Billion Tokens
item.description: A first-person case study of a Claude 5x Max account suspension on June 30th. Despite using a highly stable private Canadian VPS routed through a GL-MT3000 hardware gateway, the account was suddenly locked and refunded after an unexpected 30-minute rate limit depletion. This post investigates the top risk-control vectors: high token usage (2 billion tokens in 2 weeks triggering distillation flags), browser timezone mismatch (Asia/Hong_Kong vs. CA IP), and high Chinese language ratio, providing essential survival tips for power developers.

item.title: [Blog] Breaking News: Claude Initiates Mass Account Bans on Chinese Users!
item.description: Anthropic recently banned 1.45M accounts and was caught embedding steganography in Claude Code to detect Chinese users. This article dissects the trust crisis, uncovers the hidden tracking mechanism, and provides a hands-on guide to configuring a bulletproof environment and building a multi-model backup workflow.

item.title: Preventing Claude Code Disasters: The Essential 10-Hook Setup for AI Agents
item.description: Every Claude Code power user fears accidental force-pushes or key leaks. This guide explains how to build a robust 10-hook defensive setup using external shell scripts to intercept bad tool calls and safely guide your AI Agent in production.

item.title: Why Your LLM Doesn't Re-Read the Prompt: The Magic of KV-Cache
item.description: Discover why the KV-cache is the most critical optimization in LLM inference. This article explains how caching past Key and Value states shifts generation from quadratic to linear complexity, while discussing the memory challenges of long contexts.

item.title: Meta Reportedly Building Its Own Cloud Business to Monetize AI Compute
item.description: Meta is reportedly developing its own cloud business, "Meta Compute", to leverage and monetize its massive AI infrastructure investments. The move would pit Meta directly against hyperscalers like Amazon and Google by offering compute leasing and AI model hosting services.

item.title: Anthropic Implements New Security Guardrail for Claude Fable 5, Resolving Export Control Impasse
item.description: Anthropic has introduced a new security safeguard for its Claude Fable 5 AI model, leading the US administration to lift export controls. This measure redirects sensitive requests to a less-advanced model, preventing misuse. While resolving an immediate regulatory challenge, the company still faces ongoing supply chain risk concerns from the Department of Defense.

item.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources ASPIRE: Paradigm Shift in Embodied AI and Robot Skills
item.description: NVIDIA has released ASPIRE, a system allowing robots to learn continuously like Coding Agents by debugging and accumulating a skills library, shifting robot training from gradient descent to skill refinement.

item.title: Anthropic’s Fable 5 Restored Globally After Two-Week Government Jailbreak Ban
item.description: Following a two-week global ban triggered by a security vulnerability, Anthropic has fully restored access to its most powerful AI model, Fable 5. The ban was initiated after Amazon researchers demonstrated a jailbreak that allowed the model to identify and exploit software vulnerabilities. Anthropic resolved the issue by deploying a new safety classifier with a 99% success rate, though it introduces a higher false-positive rate. While the unrestricted "Mythos 5" remains restricted to select US organizations, Anthropic is pushing for industry-wide security standards.

item.title: OpenSquilla 0.4.0 Released: Introducing Self-Verification for AI Coding
item.description: Open-source AI Agent project OpenSquilla has released version 0.4.0, introducing an innovative 'self-verification' coding mode. By employing a 'Red-Green' regression testing pipeline, it ensures AI-generated code is proven correct before delivery, successfully tackling the trust bottleneck in autonomous AI development.

item.title: FaceMind's LoopWM Tops Hugging Face: A Breakthrough in Looped World Models
item.description: Chinese AI startup FaceMind Research Asia has topped the Hugging Face Papers list with its Loop World Models (LoopWM). Utilizing iterative latent depth, the framework lets AI agents continuously model environments with dynamic compute costs, accelerating the development of GUI Agents.

item.title: SiliconFlow Files for Hong Kong IPO, Aiming to Be First 'AI Token Factory' Stock
item.description: SiliconFlow has officially filed for a Hong Kong IPO, aiming to become the first 'AI Token Factory' stock. Backed by Alibaba and Meituan, its revenue surged by 653% in 2025. However, rapid public cloud expansion dragged its gross margin to negative 24%, with net losses widening to 345 million RMB. As complex AI Agents drive massive token demand, SiliconFlow’s infrastructure model faces its first true market trial.

item.title: Om AI Launches VLX: The First Edge Streaming Multimodal Model Series
item.description: Om AI has unveiled VLX, the world's first edge streaming multimodal model series tailored for physical AI. Consisting of VLX-Flow, VLX-Seek, and VLX-Go, the suite integrates continuous perception, precise spatial positioning, and instant physical actions with latencies down to 0.06 seconds, transforming how edge devices interact with the real world.

item.title: US Lifts Export Controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
item.description: The US Department of Commerce has lifted export controls on Anthropic's next-generation models, Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5. Anthropic announced that global access restoration will begin tomorrow.

item.title: Google Unveils Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image: Fastest and Cheapest Vision Model
item.description: Google has introduced Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image (codenamed Nano Banana 2 Lite), its fastest and cheapest image generation model designed for high-velocity and large-scale applications.

item.title: Claude Sonnet 5 Released: Near-Opus Performance with a Tokenizer Twist
item.description: Anthropic has launched Claude Sonnet 5, offering performance close to Opus 4.8 at a lower price point. It features a massive 1-million-token context window and a groundbreaking 128,000 maximum output token limit. Notably, the update deprecates classic sampling parameters like temperature and enables adaptive thinking by default. However, a new tokenizer effectively increases English and code token usage by up to 30%, whereas Simplified Mandarin token consumption remains virtually unchanged. This release marks a significant milestone for agentic workflows and long-form generation.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Sonnet 5, Bridging the Gap to Opus Series
item.description: Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5, a model designed to close the gap with the flagship Opus 4.8. Touted as the most 'agentic' Sonnet model to date, it excels at autonomous planning, tool use, and computer orchestration, while ensuring regulatory safety compliance.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Sonnet 5 to Power Cheaper, Autonomous AI Agents
item.description: Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5, a powerful mid-tier model designed to run autonomous agents at a fraction of the cost. Delivering performance close to the flagship Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5 excels in coding, tool use, and self-correction, signaling a shift in the AI race from raw capability to cost-effective agentic execution.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Science: A Workflow-First AI Workbench for Scientists
item.description: Anthropic has launched Claude Science, a dedicated AI workbench designed to streamline computational research. Rather than releasing a new model, Anthropic is focusing on workflow integration by connecting Claude models (like Opus 4.8) to over 60 scientific databases, offering multi-agent collaboration, and automating verification to simplify complex scientific processes.

item.title: Claude Code Quietly Checks Chinese Timezones and Tech Domains to Block Distillation
item.description: Analysis of Anthropic's Claude Code reveals that the tool silently checks if the user's system timezone is set to China and scans for domains of major Chinese tech companies, likely as a defensive measure to prevent model distillation.
